title: Compare-and-Select Unit
statement: Create a compare-and-select unit that outputs either the smaller or larger of two unsigned values based on a select signal. When sel is 0 the module outputs the smaller value, and when sel is 1 it outputs the larger value. This block is useful in conditional datapath steering.
module_signature: module compare_select(input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, input sel, output reg [7:0] y);
behavior: If values are equal, output may be either value.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use sequential or clocked logic.
hint: Compare a and b and use the select signal to choose the result.
